enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow under head. Remain still. Turn to right side. Push blanket down to waist. Breathe deeply. Scratch arm. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and getting ready
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink. Open cabinet. Take out lunch bag. Pack lunch. Close lunch bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag, and checking schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out belt. Put on belt. Open backpack. Place laptop inside. Place notebook inside. Place pen inside. Zip backpack. Pick up phone. Check schedule on phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to hospital by public transport (bus/train)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at train station. Exit bus. Walk to train platform. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Read book. Arrive at hospital station. Exit train. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist at the hospital, treating patients and conducting rehabilitation sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to therapy area. Greet patients. Review patient charts. Call patient name. Assist patient to treatment table. Demonstrate exercise. Guide patient's leg. Adjust patient's arm. Apply heat pack. Set timer. Remove heat pack. Assist patient to standing. Walk with patient. Guide patient through exercises. Record patient progress. Clean equipment. Walk to next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from hospital by public transport (bus/train)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Read book. Arrive at bus stop. Exit train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at home stop. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up kitchen and washing dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape food into trash. Stack dishes. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Mop floor. Empty trash. Rinse sink. Wipe stove. Put away cutting board. Put away knife. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in living room, watching TV with air conditioner on low due to heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature to low. Watch TV. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust air conditioner temperature. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bedroom, reading or using phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll. Type message. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Breathe deeply. Scratch leg. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain sleeping.
